title: Elodie and the Semester
author: Rosalind Hartwell
blurb: Mirabel Zhou, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
